audit.whatIsWrong: Three level-chart rows contradict both the packet and the prose already on the page. Rows 1, 2 and 3 read Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill in both layers; the packet reads Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen, and whys[1] literally says "You favour level 2", whys[2] says "Level 3 flattens to even", whys[3] says "You take levels 4-5".
audit.why: The page currently prints "Gangplank" above a sentence explaining why you win that level. The packet chart and the mirror audit (which states both layers were set to the packet chart) agree with the prose, so the sides are the wrong layer.
audit.corrected: Rows 1/2/3 set to Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen in BOTH layers as matched pairs, with ratings rescaled. Rows 0, 4, 5, 6 already agree and are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere, and the full layer refers to Zaahen's own kit as "your committal tool" and "your ultimate".
audit.why: Parrrley is a flat 4.5s at every rank — it is available in every single trade, which is why level 2 is still yours rather than a poke war. Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14, the longest lane cooldown either of you holds. Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120. Zaahen's Grim Deliverance is 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Parrrley's 4.5s, Remove Scurvy's 22s and Grim Deliverance's 110s written into the spikes, phases, breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) "E Golden Onslaught" is not a Zaahen ability — his E is Aureate Rush. (b) The ability is Powder Keg, written throughout as "Powder Kegs". (c) Two decisive interactions were absent: Remove Scurvy heals as well as cleanses, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both: needs-antiheal on Remove Scurvy, and resistances-invalidated on Cannon Barrage. The second one actively misleads — the itemization advice is Plated Steelcaps, and armour does nothing against the true damage that finishes you. Anti-heal timing is what decides the extended trade, and nothing on the page mentioned Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Aureate Rush named, Powder Keg singular, Remove Scurvy's heal on 22s paired with a Grievous Wounds call, and Cannon Barrage's true damage stated as ignoring the armour you bought.

audit.why: Plated Steelcaps still right against the barrel autos and Parrrley, but the anti-heal note now sits in the spike text where the extended trade is discussed.

edits.before: Your core trade pattern comes online — test it on his cooldown. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: before a barrel is stacked his only damage is Parrrley on a flat 4.5s, so step up and trade straight through it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: all-in through a single Powder Keg before his crit items exist, then bank the lead into wave control.

edits.before: Punish Gangplank hard when his barrels aren't set — walk up and trade with Q Darkin Glaive plus E Golden Onslaught before he chains a Q Parrrley into a barrel detonation; at levels 4-5 you can all-in through his Q poke while your passive out-heals it.
edits.after: Punish Gangplank hard when no barrel is set — walk up and trade with The Darkin Glaive plus Aureate Rush before he chains Parrrley, a flat 4.5s, into a detonation; at levels 4-5 you all-in through that poke while Determination heals you through it.

edits.before: Once Gangplank completes Sheen or Essence Reaver his barrel chains crit and burn for huge burst; his W Remove Scurvy cleanses your CC and his Q pokes outrange your walk-up.
edits.after: Once Gangplank finishes Sheen his barrel chains crit and burn; Remove Scurvy both cleanses your CC and heals him on 22s, so bring Grievous Wounds before any long trade.

edits.before: Two items deep Gangplank one-shots with a full barrel chain and self-peels with W and R slow zones; play safe, dodge barrels, and never stand where two can connect.
edits.after: Two items deep a full barrel chain one-shots, and Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores the armour you bought; dodge barrels and never stand where two can connect.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is skill, but you edge level 2: before Gangplank has barrels stacked, his only damage is Q Parrrley, so you walk up and trade while your passive heals through the poke.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is skill, but you edge level 2: before a barrel is stacked his only damage is Parrrley on 4.5s, so walk up and trade while The Darkin Glaive heals you through the poke.

edits.before: With items Gangplank takes over: Sheen-empowered barrel chains crit and burn for a full one-shot, W Remove Scurvy cleanses your engage, and R slow zones peel you off, so dodge barrels and never let two connect.
edits.after: With items Gangplank takes over: Sheen barrel chains crit and burn for a one-shot, Remove Scurvy cleanses your engage and heals on 22s, and Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores armour — never let two barrels connect.

edits.before: Cleanse your engage CC with W Remove Scurvy
edits.after: Cleanse and heal off Remove Scurvy every 22s

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Powder Keg (E): matchup-defining — pop each barrel to deny the chain and the gold. - Parrrley (Q): flat 4.5s, so expect it in every trade. - Grim Deliverance (R): 110s and it heals off its own damage — kill windows only.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Pop each barrel to deny the chain and the gold. Commit only once none are set.

edits.before: Your R is the kill window — build your teamfight around that. Gangplank carry threat: 9.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage on 110s — build the fight around it. Gangplank threat 9.5/10: shift to picks and wave control if he leads.

notes: Biggest find: the level chart printed Gangplank as the winner of levels 2-3 directly above prose explaining why Zaahen wins them. Both layers were wrong in the same direction, so no full/content disagreement existed to catch it — the packet and the prose were the evidence. Rows 1/2/3 proposed as matched pairs. Also killed the fabricated Zaahen ability name "Golden Onslaught" (his E is Aureate Rush). Powder Keg is still written as the plural "Powder Kegs" in ~15 remaining short strings (loading, focus.text, report[*], dosFull[0].t) that fall under the 25-character skip or would break the length band on their own; the substantive strings are fixed.
